title: Dynamic Graph Neural Networks for Socially Aware Multi-Robot Navigation in Crowds

contributions.purpose: 为多机器人社会化导航提出统一图神经网络架构
contributions.mechanism: 把机器人与行人建为时变图节点,边编码空间邻近与时序交互,DGNN(MLP消息+GRU状态+距离加权社会感知)端到端输出导航动作
contributions.evaluation: ROS/Gazebo仿真,最多10机器人50行人,轻/中/重三密度
contributions.source_quote: a DGNN architecture for multi-robot social navigation

contributions.purpose: 证明方法在安全与效率上优于经典规划器
contributions.mechanism: 对A*/RRT*/ORCA做20次随机试验的配对t检验(Cohen's d、BH-FDR校正)
contributions.evaluation: 冲突率5.7% vs ORCA 8.2(降~30%);travel time 35.0s vs RRT* 43.1(降~15%);社会成本0.008 vs ORCA 0.018,p<0.001
contributions.source_quote: the DGNN planner lowers robot-human conflict rate by 30% and average travel time by 15% compared to RRT* and A* baselines

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现仿真套件并研究AI主导科研流程
contributions.mechanism: 开放ROS/Gazebo仿真资产;AI主导假设/模型/实验/分析/写作,人类监督
contributions.evaluation: 消融证实时序模块与社会感知加权有效(去距离权重冲突率7.8,去时序6.5);代码待录用后释放
contributions.source_quote: a reproducible simulation suite to support future work; and (4) a study of an AI agent leading the research workflow under expert supervision

self_declared_provenance.quote: Many prior methods either model pedestrians and robots separately or require manual social cost tuning, and they do not scale well in dense, dynamic scenes... Our DGNN encodes robots and pedestrians in one dynamic graph and includes social comfort signals.

notes: 数字内部不一致(红旗):摘要与结论称30%/15%是相对RRT*和A*,但Results正文明确冲突率降30%是vs ORCA、travel time降15%是vs RRT*;冲突率5.7 vs A*11.2实为~49%降幅,口径混乱。所有表格数字异常整齐(mean±std),代码「待录用后释放」无法核验。失败模式(重密度聚集/窄道振荡)与消融trade-off有交代。AI Involvement Checklist:AI主导概念/模型/实验/分析/写作,人类仅审查。4条声明贡献,C4(AI主导流程研究)并入C3。
